reviews.comment:
We have two very different dogs, a young Doberman with a lot of energy and a senior Yorkie who needs extra care. Both did amazing here. Our Doberman came home calm and happy, which tells me he got plenty of play and movement. Our Yorkie came home comfortable and relaxed, which is not easy at his age.

What meant a lot to us is that we were not charged extra like we have been at other places. There were no added fees for extra play time for our Doberman and no daily add on charges for our senior Yorkie because of his needs. The care felt genuine, not transactional.

You can tell the dogs are treated as individuals, not numbers. We felt complete peace leaving them here and would trust them again without hesitation. We are very thankful we found Four Paws Inn
